import os,socket,json,hashlib,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
assert socket.gethostname()=='Agilex7Workstation' and os.getuid()==1000
p=Path('/opt/altera/26.1.1/quartus/linux64/libdb_acf.so');r={}
s=subprocess.run(['nm','-D','-C',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
r['symbols']=[l for l in s.splitlines() if re.search('enum|choice|value|assignment.*table|acf.*table',l,re.I)]
s=subprocess.run(['objdump','-d','-C',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
ls=s.splitlines();inds=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if re.search('421df0|32bd38',l)]
r['disassembly']=[ls[max(0,i-30):i+45] for i in inds]
payload=json.dumps(r).encode();subprocess.run(['tmux','load-buffer','-b','msa-router-774bbd7adba3','-'],input=payload,check=True)
